SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INST_INFO WHERE 1 = 1 AND TYPEBIG_NM != 'null'
AND FULL_NM LIKE '%' || #{fullNm} || '%'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * , ROW_NUMBER() OVER() AS RNUM FROM ( SELECT ORG_CD , FULL_NM , LOW_NM , ABBR_NM , GAP_NO , RANK_NO , SUB_CHASU , HIGH_CD , HIGHST_CD , REP_CD , TYPEBIG_NM , TYPEMID_NM , TYPESML_NM , LOCATSTD_CD , (SELECT LOCATADD_NM FROM STDG_INFO WHERE LOCATSTD_CD = REGION_CD ) AS LOCATSTD_NM , USE_CD , CRT_DE , CLS_DE , STOP_SELT , CHG_DE , BASE_DATE , ADPT_DATE , PREORG_CD FROM INST_INFO WHERE 1 = 1 AND TYPEBIG_NM != 'null'
AND FULL_NM LIKE '%' || #{fullNm} || '%'
ORDER BY ORG_CD ) T1 ) T2 WHERE 1=1
AND RNUM > #{firstRecordIndex} AND RNUM <= #{lastRecordIndex}
SELECT TYPEBIG_NM FROM INST_INFO WHERE 1=1 AND TYPEBIG_NM != 'null' GROUP BY TYPEBIG_NM

SELECT ORG_CD , FULL_NM , LOW_NM , ABBR_NM , GAP_NO , RANK_NO , SUB_CHASU , HIGH_CD , HIGHST_CD , REP_CD , TYPEBIG_NM , TYPEMID_NM , TYPESML_NM , LOCATSTD_CD , (SELECT LOCATADD_NM FROM STDG_INFO WHERE LOCATSTD_CD = REGION_CD ) AS LOCATSTD_NM , USE_CD , CRT_DE , CLS_DE , STOP_SELT , CHG_DE , BASE_DATE , ADPT_DATE , PREORG_CD FROM INST_INFO WHERE 1=1
AND ORG_CD LIKE '%' || #{orgCd} || '%'
